page.layout: One page of text, no columns and no marginal notes. Only show-through from the reverse side is visible, mirrored and upside down, with a red initial and red words among it. A vertical strip of printed text runs along the right edge.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from show-through: mirrored, upside-down text from the other side, faintly printed over the whole sheet, with red initials and red words that belong to that other side. Show-through is not transcribed, so no text is given. The vertical text at the right edge is also mirrored and too faint to read. No page number, running head, catchword or signature can be made out. Dark stains and marks on the sheet are not printed text.
